### Keywords in Context

```{r}

# convert headlines into a corpus; converting tokens into DFM
set.seed(2025)

kwic_viz = function(df, word){
  
  tokens <- corpus(df, text_field = "excerpts") %>%
  tokens(remove_punct = TRUE, remove_numbers = TRUE, remove_symbols = TRUE, remove_url = TRUE) %>%
  tokens_remove(pattern = stopwords("en")) %>%
  tokens_tolower()
  


# find contexts around inclusion
  toks <- tokens_context(tokens, word, window = 6L, valuetype = "fixed", hard_cut = FALSE, rm_keyword = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)


  flat_toks <- unlist(toks)



  word_counts <- tibble(word = flat_toks) %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE)

  word_counts %>%
    slice_max(n, n = 15) %>%  # top 15 words
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(word, n), y = n)) +
    geom_col(fill = "dodgerblue") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = paste0("Most Common Words Around '", str_to_title(word), "'"),
         x = "Word", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal()
  
}


fg01 = kwic_viz(diversity_df, 'diversity')
fg01
ggsave(filename = file.path(root, "Outputs/fg01-diversity-kwic.jpg"), plot = fg01, height = 10, width = 15, dpi = 1000)


fg02 = kwic_viz(equity_df, 'equity')
fg02
ggsave(filename = file.path(root, "Outputs/fg02-equity-kwic.jpg"), plot = fg01, height = 10, width = 15, dpi = 1000)

fg03 = kwic_viz(inclusion_df, 'inclusion')
fg03
ggsave(filename = file.path(root, "Outputs/fg03-inclusion-kwic.jpg"), plot = fg01, height = 10, width = 15, dpi = 1000)


```

### Word Embeddings

##### Inclusion

```{r}
#trump_inclusion_data = inclusion_df[inclusion_df$publication_date < '2021-01-20',]
#biden_inclusion_data = inclusion_df[inclusion_df$publication_date >= '2021-01-20' & inclusion_df$publication_date < '2025-01-20' ,]

library(text2vec) # for implementation of GloVe algorithm
library(stringr) # to handle text strings
library(umap) # for dimensionality reduction later on


# tokenizing as usual
toks <- tokens(inclusion_df$excerpts,
               remove_punct=T, 
               remove_symbols=T, 
               remove_numbers=T, 
               remove_separators=T) %>%
  tokens_remove(pattern = stopwords("en"))
  

# only use features that appear at least X times in the corpus
feats <- dfm(toks, tolower=T, verbose = FALSE) %>% 
  dfm_trim(min_termfreq = 10) %>% 
  featnames()

# remove words not in feats from the original toks but leave the pads so that non-adjacent words will not become adjacent
# rather than removing them which would mess up the original word positions
toks_feats <- tokens_select(toks,
                            feats,
                            padding = TRUE)


WINDOW_SIZE <- 6 # size of the window for counting co-occurence
DIM <- 300 # dimensions of the embeddings = size of word embeddings
ITERS <- 100 # iterations of the models
COUNT_MIN <- 10 # minimum count of words that we want to keep

# Construct the feature co-occurrence matrix for our tokens object
toks_fcm <- fcm(toks_feats, 
                context = "window", 
                window = WINDOW_SIZE, 
                count = "frequency", 
                tri = FALSE) # important to set tri = FALSE; keeps a full matrix

#head(toks_fcm)

# ---------- 3. Estimate glove model using text2vec

# Set parameters
glove <- GlobalVectors$new(rank = DIM, 
                           x_max = 10,
                           learning_rate = 0.05)

# Fit in a pythonic style!
start = Sys.time()

# Train the model
wv_main <- glove$fit_transform(toks_fcm, 
                               n_iter = ITERS,
                               convergence_tol = 1e-3, 
                               n_threads = parallel::detectCores()) # set to 'parallel::detectCores()' to use all available cores
end = Sys.time()
print(end-start)
saveRDS(wv_main, file = file.path(root, "Raw_Data/local_glove_inclusion.rds"))
saveRDS(glove, file = file.path(root, "Raw_Data/local_glove_context_inclusion.rds"))


word_vectors_context <- glove$components
#str(glove)

inclusion_word_vectors <- wv_main + t(word_vectors_context) # combined word embedding matrix
#word_vectors
# features?
#head(rownames(word_vectors))

# Find nearest words to "inclusion"
nearest_words <- function(word_vectors, keyword, n = 5) {
  similarities <- sim2(x = word_vectors, y = word_vectors[keyword, , drop = FALSE], method = "cosine", norm = "l2")
  head(sort(similarities[, 1], decreasing = TRUE)[-1], n)
}

nearest_words(inclusion_word_vectors, "inclusion", 5)

```

#### Causal Word Embeddings
```{r}
inclusion_df$trump = case_when(inclusion_df$publication_date < '2021-01-20' ~ 1,
                                   TRUE ~0)

inclusion_df$biden = case_when(inclusion_df$publication_date >= '2021-01-20' & inclusion_df$publication_date < '2025-01-20' ~ 1,
                                   TRUE ~0)

inclusion_corpus = corpus(tolower(inclusion_df$excerpts), docvars = data.frame(trump = inclusion_df$trump, group = inclusion_df$trump))

# tokenize
toks <- tokens(inclusion_corpus, remove_punct = T, remove_symbols = T, remove_numbers = T, remove_url = T, remove_separators = T)

# find contexts around empire
toks_inclusion <- tokens_context(toks, "inclusion", window = 6L, valuetype = "fixed", hard_cut = FALSE, rm_keyword = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)

# Create a feature co-occurrence matrix (FCM)
fcm_inclusion <- fcm(toks, context = "window", tri = FALSE, window = 6)

transform_matrix_inclusion = compute_transform(fcm_inclusion,inclusion_word_vectors, weighting = 2 )
dim(transform_matrix_inclusion)
dim(inclusion_word_vectors)
# Map document indices in contexts to rows in the design matrix
transform_matrix <- X[contexts$doc_id, ]

inclusion_models <- lapply(unique(docvars(toks_inclusion, 'trump')), function(j){
  conText(formula =  . ~ group, data = tokens_subset(toks_inclusion, trump == j), pre_trained = inclusion_word_vectors, transform = TRUE, transform_matrix = transform_matrix_inclusion, bootstrap = TRUE, num_bootstraps = 100, confidence_level = 0.95, stratify = TRUE, permute = TRUE, num_permutations = 100, window = 6L, valuetype = 'fixed', case_insensitive = TRUE, hard_cut = FALSE, verbose = TRUE)
 })

plot_tibble_inclusion <- lapply(inclusion_models, function(i) i@normed_coefficients) %>% do.call(rbind, .) %>% mutate(period = period)

# Tokenize text
corp <- corpus(inclusion_df$excerpts)
tokens <- tokens(corp, remove_punct = TRUE) %>%
  tokens_tolower() %>%
  tokens_remove(stopwords("en"))

# Create a vocabulary
vocab <- create_vocabulary(tokens)
vocab <- prune_vocabulary(vocab, term_count_min = 10)  # adjust as needed

# Create documents
docs <- create_documents(tokens, vocab)

# Create contexts where "inclusion" is the keyword
contexts_inclusion <- get_contexts(
  docs = docs,
  window = 5,
  only = "inclusion"  # Focuses the contexts *only* on "inclusion"
)

```

### LDA - Structural

```{r}
dfm_inclusion <- corpus(inclusion_df, text_field = "excerpts") %>%
  tokens(remove_punct = TRUE, remove_numbers = TRUE, remove_symbols = TRUE) %>%
  dfm() %>%  
  dfm_wordstem() %>%  
  dfm_remove(stopwords("en")) 

dfm_inclusion_clean <- dfm_trim(dfm_inclusion, min_docfreq = 1)

# Remove empty documents
dfm_inclusion_clean <- dfm_inclusion_clean[ntoken(dfm_inclusion_clean) > 0, ]

library(topicmodels)
# set a seed so that the output of the model is predictable
lda <- LDA(dfm_inclusion_clean, k = 4, control = list(seed = 1234, alpha = 0.1), method = "Gibbs")
lda

library(tidytext)
topics <- tidy(lda, matrix = "beta")


top_terms <- topics %>%
  group_by(topic) %>%
  slice_max(beta, n = 10) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(topic, -beta)

# Plot top words per topic
top_terms %>%
  mutate(term = reorder_within(term, beta, topic)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(beta, term, fill = factor(topic))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  labs(title = "Top Words in Each Topic", x = "Word Probability (Beta)", y = "Word") +
  theme_minimal()



```

### LDA - Key words

```{r}
dfm_inclusion_context <- corpus(inclusion_df, text_field = "excerpts") %>%
  tokens(remove_punct = TRUE, remove_numbers = TRUE, remove_symbols = TRUE) %>%
  tokens_context(pattern = 'inclusion', window = 6L, valuetype = "fixed", hard_cut = FALSE, rm_keyword = TRUE, verbose = TRUE) %>%
  dfm() %>%  
  dfm_wordstem() %>%  
  dfm_remove(stopwords("en")) 

dfm_inclusion_clean_context <- dfm_trim(dfm_inclusion_context, min_docfreq = 1)

# Remove empty documents
dfm_inclusion_clean_context <- dfm_inclusion_clean_context[ntoken(dfm_inclusion_clean_context) > 0, ]

library(topicmodels)
# set a seed so that the output of the model is predictable
lda_context <- LDA(dfm_inclusion_clean_context, k = 4, control = list(seed = 1234))
#lda

library(tidytext)
topics_context <- tidy(lda_context, matrix = "beta")


top_terms_context <- topics_context %>%
  group_by(topic) %>%
  slice_max(beta, n = 10) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(topic, -beta)

# Plot top words per topic
top_terms_context %>%
  mutate(term = reorder_within(term, beta, topic)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(beta, term, fill = factor(topic))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  labs(title = "Top Words in Each Topic", x = "Word Probability (Beta)", y = "Word") +
  theme_minimal()


```
